exposure: Tranexamic acid administration during induction of regional anesthesia
outcome: Reactions or hemodynamic changes due to tranexamic acid
cohort: The study included 48 antenatal patients presenting for repeat C-section delivery, classified as ASA I and II, with no systemic co-morbidities.
finding: Tranexamic acid can be safely used during induction of anesthesia in repeat C-sections, resulting in minimal blood loss and nil side effects.
mod_finding: The study found that tranexamic acid can be safely and effectively used during repeat C-sections to minimize blood loss and side effects.
